title: Convert Maa Bhawani Store to Progressive Web App

requirements.summary: Configure PWA capabilities with web manifest and app icons
acceptanceCriteria: Web manifest file is created with app name 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point'
Multiple icon sizes are provided (192x192, 512x512 minimum)
Display mode is set to 'standalone' for app-like experience
Theme color matches the store's warm earthy color scheme
Orientation is configured for optimal mobile viewing

file_operations.description: Create web app manifest with app name 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point', short_name, description, start_url, display mode 'standalone', orientation 'portrait', theme_color matching the warm earthy palette from index.css (oklch(0.55 0.15 40)), background_color, and icons array referencing the generated app icon images at frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon-192.dim_192x192.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon-512.dim_512x512.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png with appropriate sizes and types.

Add link to manifest.json in the head section and wire the generated app icons: add <link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.json">, <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/assets/generated/apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png">, and <link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="192x192" href="/assets/generated/app-icon-192.dim_192x192.png">.

requirements.summary: Add service worker for offline functionality and app installation
acceptanceCriteria: Service worker is registered in the main application entry point
Critical application assets are cached on installation
App can display cached content when offline
Users receive installation prompts on supported mobile browsers

file_operations.description: Create service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets (HTML, CSS, JS, images including generated images from frontend/public/assets/generated/), network-first strategy for API calls to the backend, install event to cache critical assets, fetch event to serve cached content with network fallback, and activate event to clean old caches.

Register the service worker after React app initialization by adding service worker registration code that checks for navigator.serviceWorker support and registers /service-worker.js with error handling and console logging for registration success/failure.

requirements.summary: Optimize mobile experience with touch interactions and gestures
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons and interactive elements meet minimum touch target size of 44x44px
Cart drawer supports swipe gestures for opening and closing
Touch feedback is provided for all interactive elements
Mobile navigation is optimized for one-handed use

file_operations.description: Add global CSS rules for touch-friendly interactions: minimum touch target sizes (min-height: 44px, min-width: 44px) for buttons and interactive elements, active state styles with scale transform for touch feedback, and tap-highlight-color settings for better mobile experience.

Add touch gesture support for swipe-to-close functionality by implementing touch event handlers (onTouchStart, onTouchMove, onTouchEnd) that detect horizontal swipe gestures and close the drawer when user swipes right beyond a threshold distance, including visual feedback during the swipe.

Ensure all navigation buttons and the cart button meet minimum 44x44px touch target size by adjusting padding and height values, and optimize mobile navigation layout for one-handed use with larger tap areas.
Ensure the floating call button meets minimum 44x44px touch target size and add touch feedback with active state scaling and appropriate positioning for one-handed mobile use.

requirements.summary: Update HTML meta tags for mobile app configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Viewport meta tag is configured with width=device-width, initial-scale=1
Apple mobile web app capable meta tags are added
Status bar styling is configured for iOS
Android theme color is set to match app design

file_operations.description: Add mobile-specific meta tags in the head section: verify viewport meta tag includes width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=5, user-scalable=yes; add <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">; add <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">; add <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Maa Bhawani Store">; and add <meta name="theme-color" content="oklch(0.55 0.15 40)"> matching the warm earthy theme color from the design system.
